hero.title: Mining moves resources. Reputation moves everything else.
hero.description: Mining & Reputation helps mining companies build trust, protect their reputation and communicate effectively with the stakeholders who shape their future.

about.titleLine1: Mining is built on more than resources.
about.description1: Mining companies operate at the intersection of communities, governments, investors, media and public opinion. In this environment, reputation is not simply a communications issue — it is a strategic asset.
about.description2: Mining & Reputation supports mining companies in understanding their stakeholders, building credible narratives, navigating sensitive issues and strengthening the relationships that sustain their licence to operate.

expertise.heading: Expertise for every dimension of reputation
expertise.intro: From community relations to crisis management, we help mining organisations communicate with clarity, credibility and consistency.

crisis.title: Crisis Communication
crisis.description: Prepare for critical situations, protect trust and communicate decisively when the stakes are highest.

media.title: Media Relations & Spokesperson Strategy
media.description: Build strong media relationships, strengthen executive visibility and ensure your organisation is represented with clarity and authority.

esg.title: ESG, CSR & Social Licence to Operate
esg.description: Translate commitments into credible narratives that demonstrate impact, responsibility and long-term value.

community.title: Community Relations
community.description: Build stronger dialogue with local communities and stakeholders around mining operations and projects.

financial.title: Financial Communication
financial.description: Communicate strategic information clearly to investors, partners and financial stakeholders.

digital.title: Digital Reputation & Monitoring
digital.description: Understand how your organisation is perceived online, detect emerging issues and protect your reputation across digital channels.

sectors.heading: Understanding mining means understanding its realities.
sectors.intro: Different commodities, geographies and stages of development create different communication challenges. Our approach is adapted to the realities of each project and market.

gold.title: Gold & Precious Metals
